before.title: How Did Experiments Explain Blood, Germs and Atoms?
before.descriptionLine1: How did experiments explain blood, germs and atoms? Six discovery stories follow the evidence across almost three hundred years, from a tied arm and a willow tree to a swan-neck flask, the periodic table, X-rays and gold foil.

afterApi.title: Experiments That Changed the World (Blood, Germs and Atoms)
